steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In November 2025, Equity Mates noted PlayStation 5 appearing in Black Friday shopping and used it to illustrate how strong, gift‑driven demand can point to a product with real consumer pull and likely solid sales for Sony.

episode.title: An investors guide to Black Friday

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In March 2026, Equity Mates reported Sony delayed PlayStation 6 from 2027 to 2029 due to soaring DRAM costs, highlighting supply pressures that could affect the console cycle and the timing of gaming earnings.

episode.title: The eBay harassment scandal, RAMageddon explained & Pimp My Portfolio with Matt Ingram

views.text: In October 2020, Equity Mates compared 2017 gaming revenues and said Sony ranked second with US$10.5 billion, underscoring its scale in the industry behind Tencent.

episode.title: Industry Deep Dive: Video Game Industry

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In February 2023, Equity Mates said Sony Network Communications partnered with Astar Network to run a Web3 incubation program for NFT and DAO projects, showing Sony exploring new technologies and potential business models.

episode.title: 67 -  Exploring the World of Ordinal NFTs, the SEC's Crackdown, CBDCs & the emergence of Blur Marketplace

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In May 2023, Equity Mates covered a conference pitch that Sony was misunderstood by Wall Street and could rise 50% by end of FY2024, with the case built on valuable assets and a shift toward subscription and software revenue in gaming.

episode.title: We draft 6 stocks from SOHN Investment Conference New York
